name: Nursing Assistant De-escalation
summary:
Nursing Assistant De-escalation is an immersive VR training simulation that prepares learners to safely and effectively manage challenging patient interactions in healthcare environments. Through realistic scenarios, learners practice therapeutic communication, de-escalation techniques, patient-centered care, situational awareness, and safety-focused decision-making.
